run_glue_finetune: run GLUE task fine-tuning with BERT, XLNet, RoBERTa, or XLM on sequence classification
evaluate_glue_model: evaluate a fine-tuned GLUE model on dev or matched/mismatched test splits
train_distributed_model: train a transformer model with multi-GPU or distributed data parallel training
load_cached_features: load and cache GLUE dataset features for fast repeated training and evaluation
save_model_checkpoint: save a trained model checkpoint with tokenizer and training arguments to disk
